budget_items.topic: Mental Health Co-Response program cost (Lancaster partnership)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Police requested $79,032 for the co-response program, split with Lancaster, with Lunenburg as host community fronting the full amount and Lancaster reimbursing 50%.
budget_items.quote: we are requesting $79,032. this would be split between lancaster and lunenburg and we would be the host community and would have to provide the entire amount then

budget_items.topic: Mental Health Co-Response state grant application
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Police are applying to the Department of Mental Health for a grant; if received, opioid funds would be returned.
budget_items.quote: we are also applying to the dept, of mental health for a $200,000 grant.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: One bid of $517,918 received; June 2021 low bid was $298,750; $135,000 remains in the FY21 Capital Plan appropriation, so both bids exceed funds and the project will not be pursued.
budget_items.quote: we received one bid from diversified construction services for $517,918.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Single bid of $481,975 for two F750 trucks, not including trade-in values; equal to the amount committed through ARPA funding; decommissioned trucks to be sold on Municibid.
budget_items.quote: for 2 f750 trucks totaling $481,975 (not including trade in values for the de- commissioned trucks.

budget_items.topic: Community Compact Best Practices Grant request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town applied for two best practices: $30,000 for a Collins Center financial management package, and $25,000 for a bridge and culvert asset management plan.
Approximately $900,000 in local funds and Small Bridge Grant funds are committed to reconstruct the Flat Hill Road culvert.
budget_items.quote: we have approximately $900,000 in local funds and the small bridge grant funds to reconstruct

budget_items.topic: Ladder truck and Saliba property bond anticipation note
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bond anticipation note of $152,499 for a ladder truck and the Saliba property purchase, of which $96,900 is for the Saliba property; one-year renewal, signed.
budget_items.quote: this bond is for a ladder truck and the saliba property purchase in the amount of $152,499.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Consultant to help identify brownfields; consulting fee quoted as a range.
